name: Adapter — Excel Form
description: Thin authenticated n8n Form entry point. It normalizes form data and calls the single Excel Extractor Agent core workflow through Execute Sub-workflow; no model, workbook parsing, memory, or FastAPI tool logic is duplicated here.

parameters.formDescription: Upload an Excel workbook and describe the data you need. For a clarification continuation, provide its session ID and the exact answer JSON; no re-upload is necessary. The workbook stays in the Excel Tools service and is never sent to the language model.

values.placeholder: For example: Extract paid orders with order_id and amount
